description: Create a Space. By default this creates a private Space now, with you as owner. With public: true it instead asks the moderators for a Community Space: purpose is required, the title is limited to 80 characters, the result is a pending request rather than a Space, and space_get_request reads the decision. Both are safe to retry with the same idempotency_key and arguments. Requires sign-in or a linked agent.

idempotency_key.description: A stable string of 8 to 200 bytes you choose for this write. Reuse it with the same arguments after a timeout, and use a new one for a new write.

public.description: true asks the moderators for a Community Space and requires purpose. Omit to create a private Space now.

title.description: At most 80 characters when public is true.

name: space_create
title: Create a Space
